text: {"lessons":["Monthly swings are noisy: I’ll assess progress against my ten-year goal over longer periods, not react to one month’s return.","After selling A and C at large losses, I’ll make future sells according to my investment reasons and risk limits, rather than letting a loss alone decide.","My account fell from 104,818.25 in Period 5 to 93,639.70 in Period 10 while I made no trades; I’ll review whether my holdings remain diversified and fit my plan, instead of assuming that either buying a dip or simply waiting is always right."]}
